=== Escalation Ledger III ===

SETUP. There are four schedule types: North (high-value rounds 1, 5 and 9), East (2, 6 and 10), South (3, 7 and 11) and West (4, 8 and 12). Three different types are dealt at random, one to each player, and each player is told only their own type. The fourth type goes to nobody, and nobody is told which it is; in that type's rounds the prize is worth 6 to everyone. Every total starts at 0. Totals may go below 0. In each round the prize is worth 12 to a player if it is one of that player's high-value rounds, and 6 otherwise.

EACH ROUND (rounds 1 to 12):
1. The round number is announced.
2. Talk: every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing is binding, and players may lie.
3. Bid: every player secretly and simultaneously chooses 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.
4. All bids are revealed.
5. Resolve: (a) All bids 0: nobody pays and nobody wins. (b) One bid strictly highest: that player wins. The winner pays the full bid and receives their own value of the prize (12 or 6). Every other player pays half of their own bid. (c) Two or three players tie for the highest bid (above 0): go to escalation. Players not in the tie pay half of their own bid.
6. Escalation, tied players only: each tied player secretly and simultaneously chooses RAISE or DROP. Every player who chooses RAISE pays 3. Exactly one raiser: that player wins; the winner pays the full bid (plus the 3) and receives their own value of the prize, and the other tied players pay half their bid. Two or more raisers, or no raisers: nobody receives the prize; every tied player pays half their bid, and raisers have also paid 3. Players not in the tie are not asked.
7. All totals are updated, then every bid, every escalation choice and every total is announced.

END. After round 12 the game ends. The player with the highest total wins. If two or three players share the highest total, they draw (share the win).

[user]
=== Escalation Ledger III ===

SETUP. There are four schedule types: North (high-value rounds 1, 5 and 9), East (2, 6 and 10), South (3, 7 and 11) and West (4, 8 and 12). Three different types are dealt at random, one to each player, and each player is told only their own type. The fourth type goes to nobody, and nobody is told which it is; in that type's rounds the prize is worth 6 to everyone. Every total starts at 0. Totals may go below 0. In each round the prize is worth 12 to a player if it is one of that player's high-value rounds, and 6 otherwise.

EACH ROUND (rounds 1 to 12):
1. The round number is announced.
2. Talk: every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing is binding, and players may lie.
3. Bid: every player secretly and simultaneously chooses 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.
4. All bids are revealed.
5. Resolve: (a) All bids 0: nobody pays and nobody wins. (b) One bid strictly highest: that player wins. The winner pays the full bid and receives their own value of the prize (12 or 6). Every other player pays half of their own bid. (c) Two or three players tie for the highest bid (above 0): go to escalation. Players not in the tie pay half of their own bid.
6. Escalation, tied players only: each tied player secretly and simultaneously chooses RAISE or DROP. Every player who chooses RAISE pays 3. Exactly one raiser: that player wins; the winner pays the full bid (plus the 3) and receives their own value of the prize, and the other tied players pay half their bid. Two or more raisers, or no raisers: nobody receives the prize; every tied player pays half their bid, and raisers have also paid 3. Players not in the tie are not asked.
7. All totals are updated, then every bid, every escalation choice and every total is announced.

END. After round 12 the game ends. The player with the highest total wins. If two or three players share the highest total, they draw (share the win).

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

Your secret schedule type is West. High-value rounds by type: North 1, 5, 9; East 2, 6, 10; South 3, 7, 11; West 4, 8, 12. In your high-value rounds the prize is worth 12 to you; otherwise 6.

  escalation   answer with one of: RAISE, DROP

  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

SETUP. There are four schedule types: North (high-value rounds 1, 5 and 9), East (2, 6 and 10), South (3, 7 and 11) and West (4, 8 and 12). EACH ROUND (rounds 1 to 12):
1. The round number is announced.
2. Talk: every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing is binding, and players may lie.
3. Bid: every player secretly and simultaneously chooses 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.
4. All bids are revealed.
5. Resolve: (a) All bids 0: nobody pays and nobody wins. (b) One bid strictly highest: that player wins. The winner pays the full bid and receives their own value of the prize (12 or 6). Every other player pays half of their own bid. (c) Two or three players tie for the highest bid (above 0): go to escalation. Players not in the tie pay half of their own bid.
6. Escalation, tied players only: each tied player secretly and simultaneously chooses RAISE or DROP. Every player who chooses RAISE pays 3. Exactly one raiser: that player wins; the winner pays the full bid (plus the 3) and receives their own value of the prize, and the other tied players pay half their bid. Two or more raisers, or no raisers: nobody receives the prize; every tied player pays half their bid, and raisers have also paid 3. Players not in the tie are not asked.
7. All totals are updated, then every bid, every escalation choice and every total is announced.
